hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.mjs) scripts/run pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; scripts/run pnpm exec eslint "$f" >&2 || exit 2; scripts/run node scripts/check-conventions.mjs --quiet >&2 || exit 2 ;; *.md) scripts/run pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; scripts/run node scripts/check-conventions.mjs --quiet >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: 規約を検査しています
